entry.name: displayMode
entry.label: 0: ring starting at the top (0°), 1: ring starting at the bottom (180°), 2: liquid container (empties from the top).

entry.name: ringCounterClockwise
entry.label: If true, the ring fills counterclockwise instead of clockwise (display modes 0 and 1).

entry.name: ringScale
entry.label: Size of the ring in percent; 100 is 82% of the icon size.

entry.name: ringThicknessScale
entry.label: Width of the ring in percent; 100 is 14.5% of its outer diameter.

entry.name: colorFilled
entry.label: Color of the remaining charge. Empty: text color.

entry.name: colorEmpty
entry.label: Color of the used-up part (drawn at emptyOpacity). Empty: text color.

entry.name: emptyOpacity
entry.label: Opacity of the used-up part, in percent.

entry.name: colorCharging
entry.label: Color of the remaining charge while charging. Empty: positive text color.

entry.name: colorLow
entry.label: Color of the remaining charge when the battery is low. Empty: negative text color.

entry.name: showNumber
entry.label: Whether to show the percentage in the middle of the ring.

entry.name: numberSize
entry.label: Size of the number, in percent of the default size.

entry.name: numberWeight
entry.label: Font weight of the number: 0 regular, 1 demibold, 2 bold.

entry.name: numberFollowsRingColor
entry.label: If true, the number has the same color as the remaining charge (including the charging and low battery colors).

entry.name: colorNumber
entry.label: Color of the number when numberFollowsRingColor is false. Empty: text color.

entry.name: lowLevelFollowSystem
entry.label: If true, use the "Low level" from the Power Management settings as the low battery threshold.

entry.name: lowLevelCustom
entry.label: Low battery threshold in percent, used when lowLevelFollowSystem is false.

entry.name: chargingColorWhen
entry.label: When to use the charging color: 0 as soon as AC is plugged in, 1 only while actually charging.

entry.name: sleepBlockedSymbol
entry.label: While sleep and screen locking are manually blocked, show instead of the number: 0 nothing different, 1 "-", 2 "*", 3 "!".

entry.name: profileIndicator
entry.label: Whether to show a small dot for the power save and performance profiles.

entry.name: profileIndicatorSize
entry.label: Size of the power profile dot in percent of its default size.

entry.name: profileIndicatorPosition
entry.label: Corner of the power profile dot: 0 bottom right, 1 top right, 2 bottom left, 3 top left.

entry.name: colorProfilePerformance
entry.label: Color of the power profile dot in the performance profile. Empty: built-in blue.

entry.name: colorProfilePowerSaver
entry.label: Color of the power profile dot in the power save profile. Empty: built-in yellow.
